description:
Ğ1 Wallet: simple, quick, modern and versatile
G1nkgo is compatible with any other wallet in the Duniter network.

Enjoy a fast and secure way to carry out transactions, check your balance, and
manage your Ğ1 funds, even without passwords, anytime and anywhere.

Write private messages to anyone in the network, through the same Cesium+ inbox
that Cesium and Ğecko already use. Messages are end to end encrypted, they travel
through public community pods you can choose yourself, and you can delete them
whenever you want. Anyone who bothers you can be blocked and reported from
the app itself.

G1nkgo is Free Software.
